title: Iran Plane Suffers Cabin Damage After Tyre Burst During Emergency Landing
summary: A Sepehran Airlines Boeing 737 experienced severe turbulence and cabin damage, including the detachment of its roof liner, during an emergency landing in Mashhad, Iran. The incident occurred after a suspected tyre burst caused the aircraft to shake violently. Belongings and the cabin's roof liner reportedly detached, and the plane lost cabin pressure. The aircraft was able to land safely.
summary_points: A Sepehran Airlines Boeing 737 experienced a tyre burst during an emergency landing in Mashhad, Iran.
The incident caused the aircraft to shake violently, leading to the detachment of the cabin's roof liner.
The plane reportedly lost cabin pressure and belongings flew across the cabin.
The aircraft, however, landed safely following the emergency.

summary_points_hi: ईरान के मशहद में आपातकालीन लैंडिंग के दौरान सेपेहरान एयरलाइंस के बोइंग 737 विमान का टायर फट गया।
इस घटना के कारण विमान बुरी तरह हिलने लगा, जिससे केबिन का छत लाइनर अलग हो गया।
कथित तौर पर विमान का केबिन प्रेशर कम हो गया और सामान केबिन में उड़ने लगे।
हालांकि, आपात स्थिति के बाद विमान सुरक्षित रूप से उतर गया।
